characters.summary: Cara Dune is a seasoned former Rebel shock trooper who excels in brutal hand-to-hand combat and heavy infantry firefights. She utilizes brute force, heavy weaponry, and disciplined military tactics.

mechanisms: Exceptional physical resilience in close combat

weaknesses: Lacks supernatural or energy projection abilities
Vulnerable to superior numbers or heavy armored vehicles without anti-armor gear
limitations: Relies entirely on physical stamina and standard military gear

sources.supports: Basic biography, role as a former Rebel shock trooper, and combat style in The Mandalorian.

feats.claim: Fought off Imperial remnants alongside the Mandalorian using heavy blasters and tactical defense.

notableResults.note: Engaged in multiple successful skirmishes against Imperial forces.

campaignTags.claim: Uses advanced blasters and military equipment.

unknowns: Exact post-Season 2 status and engagements after actress departure from the franchise.

characters.summary: Cassian Andor is a resourceful Rebel intelligence officer, spy, and assassin. He relies heavily on stealth, precision marksmanship, improvised tactics, and psychological survival skills rather than overt superhuman combat.
weaknesses: Physically vulnerable without armor against direct heavy firepower
Lacks superhuman durability or powers
limitations: Dependent on available equipment and intelligence

sources.supports: Role as a Rebel intelligence officer, spy, and skilled marksman.

feats.claim: Infiltrated secure Imperial installations on multiple planets and successfully extracted intelligence.
feats.citation: Andor / Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

notableResults.citation: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
notableResults.note: Successfully completed missions against high-security Imperial targets through stealth and precision.

campaignTags.claim: Operates extensively as an undercover spy and infiltrator within Imperial facilities.
Executes missions using covert movement and stealth tactics.
Utilizes standard-issue rebel blasters, datapad slicers, and espionage tools.

unknowns: Full extent of his pre-Rebellion operations as 'Fulcrum' agent.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (Films and TV Series)
characters.summary: Chewbacca is a towering Wookiee warrior possessing immense physical strength, durability, and fierce loyalty. He specializes in ferocious close-quarters combat and devastating firepower using his signature bowcaster.

mechanisms: Natural Wookiee physical resilience and dense musculature
Thick fur coat offering minor environmental protection

weaknesses: Susceptible to emotional distress over losing companions
Vulnerable to coordinated heavy stun fire or overwhelming technological suppression
limitations: Prone to berserker rages that can bypass tactical caution

sources.supports: Biography, physical characteristics, weapon usage, and role as Han Solo's co-pilot.

feats.claim: Ripped the arms off opponents in cantenas and overpowered multiple Stormtroopers in melee combat.
feats.citation: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope

notableResults.note: Fought in numerous successful ground engagements against Imperial forces.

campaignTags.claim: Serves as the co-pilot and mechanic of the Millennium Falcon.
Expertly wields and repairs bowcasters, ship systems, and advanced technology.

unknowns: Full upper limit of Wookiee strength thresholds under extreme stress.

characters.summary: Chirrut Îmwe is a blind spiritual warrior and a devotee of the Guardians of the Whills. He utilizes heightened sensory awareness, profound attunement to the Force, and expert martial arts with a staff and bow.
weaknesses: Physically blind, relying entirely on hearing and Force attunement
Lacks body armor or energy shielding
limitations: Physical mortality and vulnerability to standard lethal projectiles

sources.supports: Description of Chirrut Îmwe as a blind warrior monk attuned to the Force.

feats.claim: Defeated a squad of Stormtroopers in close combat using only a staff while relying on sensory perception.
feats.citation: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

feats.claim: Walked across an active battlefield through heavy crossfire guided by his spiritual connection.
feats.citation: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story

notableResults.citation: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
notableResults.note: Successfully cleared a path through enemy soldiers in close quarters.

campaignTags.claim: Channels spiritual attunement closely tied to the Force to achieve supernatural awareness.

unknowns: Whether he was officially a trained Jedi or solely a Guardian of the Whills.

characters.summary: Chopper (C1-10P) is an eccentric and brutally effective astromech droid equipped with a wide variety of hidden tools, electric shockers, rocket boosters, and aggressive weaponry. He fights with complete disregard for rules.

techniques: Built-in circular saws and welding torches

weaknesses: Prone to mechanical glitches and stubborn behavior
Vulnerable to ion weapons and strong magnetic fields
limitations: Limited battery and fuel for rocket boosters
Small physical stature restricts heavy physical lifting

sources.supports: Role of Chopper as the primary astromech droid of the Ghost crew with distinct combat capabilities.

feats.claim: Infiltrated Imperial systems, disabled security grids, and electrocuted enemy troopers.

notableResults.note: Successfully sabotaged and defeated rival droids using integrated tools and shock weapons.

campaignTags.claim: Chopper is a sentient astromech droid.
Equipped with rocket boosters allowing short bursts of flight.
Utilizes an integrated electro-shock prod in combat.
Advanced astromech droid with extensive hacking and slicing tools.

unknowns: Exact manufacturer history prior to the Clone Wars crash.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (The Mandalorian, The Book of Boba Fett)
characters.summary: Cobb Vanth is a skilled gunslinger and local lawman who protects Mos Pelgo using Boba Fett's legendary Mandalorian armor. He fights with precise quick-draw pistol marksmanship and tactical rural defense.
weaknesses: Vulnerable in areas unprotected by his borrowed Mandalorian armor
Prone to taking personal risks to protect civilians
limitations: Human physical limitations outside of armor protection

sources.supports: Biography, role as marshal of Mos Pelgo, and utilization of Mandalorian armor.

feats.claim: Killed a krayt dragon with coordinated explosive charges and blaster fire while wearing Mandalorian armor.

notableResults.note: Cleared out armed criminal gangs from settlement territory.

campaignTags.claim: Wears authentic Mandalorian beskar armor.
Utilizes the jetpack attached to his Mandalorian armor.
Wields advanced blasters and integrated armor weaponry.

unknowns: Full recovery status after being shot by Cad Bane.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (The Clone Wars, Revenge of the Sith)
characters.summary: Commander Cody (CC-2224) is a highly disciplined clone marshal commander who specializes in large-scale military strategy, tactical coordination, and heavy blaster combat.

mechanisms: Phase II Clone Trooper armor plating

weaknesses: Vulnerable to neurological override commands (inhibitor chip)
Standard human physical limitations
limitations: Strict adherence to military chain of command and orders

sources.supports: Role as a Grand Army of the Republic clone commander, tactics, and equipment.

feats.claim: Led clone battalions through complex sieges against separatist droid armies on numerous worlds.

notableResults.note: Won multiple large-scale military engagements across the galaxy.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes advanced clone trooper armor, tactical HUDs, and standard Republic blasters.
Pilots gunships and command starfighters during campaigns.

unknowns: Exact post-Clone Wars military career under the Galactic Empire.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (Star Wars: The Clone Wars, Episode III)
characters.summary: Count Dooku is a powerful Sith Lord and former Jedi Master who masters Makashi lightsaber combat and devastating Force lightning. He fights with extreme elegance, precision, and overwhelming dark side prowess.
weaknesses: Arrogance and overconfidence in his mastery over opponents
Vulnerable to relentless, heavy physical onslaughts that strain Makashi's weak multi-opponent parrying
limitations: Form II is optimized for one-on-one dueling rather than crowded melee battlefields

sources.supports: Biography, Sith status, lightsaber combat style, and Force abilities.

feats.claim: Defeated Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker simultaneously in single combat.

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
notableResults.note: Successfully defeated Kenobi in a lightsaber duel by incapacitating him.

notableResults.note: Overpowered when Skywalker tapped into unbridled dark side fury.

characters.summary: Crosshair is an elite clone commando sniper possessing exceptional genetic modifications granting peerless marksmanship and spatial calculation. He fights from extreme distance with calculated precision.
weaknesses: Vulnerable in close-quarters brawls without support
Inhibitor chip behavioral conditioning dependencies
limitations: Relies on clear lines of sight for long-range elimination

sources.supports: Description of Crosshair as a member of Clone Force 99 with exceptional sniper capabilities.

feats.claim: Hit targets over extreme distances by calculating atmospheric conditions and ricochets off walls.

notableResults.note: Successfully neutralized target groups from afar with minimal expenditure of ammunition.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes customized high-powered sniper rifles and imperial weaponry.

unknowns: Full long-term physical toll of prolonged nerve damage to his hand.

characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (The Phantom Menace, The Clone Wars, Rebels)
characters.summary: Darth Maul is a lethal Sith Lord and master of Juyo/Ataru lightsaber combat, wielding a double-bladed lightsaber. He combines acrobatic martial arts, relentless offense, and dark side Force abilities.
weaknesses: Extreme arrogance and vengeful obsession clouding tactical judgment
Vulnerable to emotional provocation
limitations: Relies heavily on aggressive momentum; can be countered by disciplined defensive styles
Cybernetic legs can be targeted by ion weapons
